topics.label: Introduction and Lecture Overview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture topic on cancer evolution and outlines the core learning objectives.

topics.label: Clonal Selection and Epigenetic Plasticity in Tumor Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how genetic driver mutations and epigenetic chromatin alterations confer competitive growth advantages during clonal evolution.

topics.label: Cell of Origin and Cancer Stem Cell Models
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics evaluate the role of tissue stem cell hierarchies, cancer stem cells, and cell-of-origin susceptibility in tumor initiation and propagation.

topics.label: Microenvironmental and Inflammatory Drivers of Tumorigenesis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how inflammatory stimuli, environmental promoters, and supportive stroma cooperate with mutations to enable tumor growth.

topics.label: Technologies for Investigating Tumor Evolution and Interactions
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic outlines single-cell sequencing and spatial profiling methods used to track tumor evolution and map cellular interactions in tissues.

topics.label: Multifactorial Framework of Cancer Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic synthesizes the interplay between genetic mutations, epigenetics, cell lineage, and microenvironmental pressures into an overarching evolutionary model.

topics.label: Conclusion and Next Lecture
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture and previews the upcoming session on cancer therapy.
